payload.voxel: [local x,local y,local z] integers from selection.voxel

coordinates: 1 voxel = 1 world unit. East +X, south +Z, up +Y. Anchor is rotated bounding-box minimum. Ground surface Y=1. quarter turn 1 maps local x,z to size_z-1-z,x.

model.palette: array of opaque sRGB #RRGGBB strings; every voxel may have its own color
model.cells_v1: cells: [[x,y,z,color_index],...]. Unique integer coordinates within size. Missing cells are air.
model.box_ops_v1: ops ordered; fill_box/clear_box use min and max_exclusive, fill_box includes color INTEGER PALETTE INDEX (not a hex color, not a string); set_voxel uses position and color INTEGER PALETTE INDEX. Last write wins. Every coordinate inside size. air is clear_box, never a palette entry.
model.grounding: At least one nonempty cell at local Y=0. No structural simulation. Empty models forbidden.

permissions: Creation owner always authenticated player. Only owner can update/demolish/destroy. All players may view all buildings. No owner_id/actor_player_id can be assigned by model or client.
placement: Rotated whole bounding rectangle must fit player zone and not overlap any building. Courtyard reserves space too. Updates preserve identity/name/position/rotation/owner.
execution: Immediate create/update/demolish. Destroy emits effect and immediately frees occupancy. No movable units, attacks, resources or construction. Stale entity revisions are rejected. One mutation per AI request.

ai_output.message: Chinese explanation of plan, never claim executed yet
ai_output.commands: Exactly one {type,payload} mutation for commands; [] otherwise. Unknown fields forbidden. Ask clarification if no unambiguous target/position.
